meta.name: higgsfield-soul-id
meta.description:
Train a Soul Character — a personalized model on a person's face that
Higgsfield uses for identity-faithful image and video generation.
Use when: "create my Soul", "train my face", "make my digital twin",
"build me an avatar", "learn my appearance", "create a character of me",
"set up identity for video", "I want my face in generated images".
Chain: train Soul (one-time, returns reference_id) → use in
higgsfield-generate via `--soul-id <id>` with models like
`text2image_soul_v2` or `soul_cinema_studio`.
NOT for: one-shot face swaps (use higgsfield-generate with --image),
named-character / non-photo avatars (use higgsfield-generate with prompt).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用你的脸部图像训练个性化模型，用于视频与图片生成
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你希望生成以你或他人脸部为特征的图像和视频
copy.tagline_en: Train a personalized model on a face for identity-consistent image and video generation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to generate images and videos that faithfully reproduce a specific person's face

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会基于你提供的 5–20 张脸部照片训练一个专属身份模型（Soul）。训练完成后，生成图片或视频时可用此模型保持你的面部特征；它也能列出或查询已有 Soul。
howto.when: 当你说“create my Soul”“train my face”“make my digital twin”“build me an avatar”等，或提出要把自己的脸放进生成的图片/视频时触发。

say.text: 用这 6 张照片训练我的 Soul，名字叫小美。
say.note: 会启动训练，完成后返回引用 ID。

say.text: 帮我创建一个数字分身，用于生成我的视频。
say.note: 会先要名字和照片，再选视频模型。

say.text: 列出我已经训练好的 Soul。
say.note: 会执行列表查询，显示已有引用。

howto.what_en: Claude will train a personalized identity model (Soul) from 5-20 face photos you provide. After training, the model can be used in image or video generation to keep the face consistent. It can also list or query existing Souls.
howto.when_en: When you say 'create my Soul', 'train my face', 'make my digital twin', 'build me an avatar', etc., or ask to put your face into generated images/videos.

say_en.text: Train my Soul with these 6 photos, name it Xiaomei.
say_en.note: Starts training and returns a reference ID.

say_en.text: Create a digital twin for generating my video.
say_en.note: Asks for name and photos, then picks the cinematic model.
Runs soul-id list to show existing references.
